question: Where are an attraction within 180 kilometers from Rex Healthcare of Wakfield, Raleigh, NC on the southwest side?
sql: SELECT poi_name FROM pois AS p_attraction WHERE p_attraction.tourism = 'attraction' AND ST_DWithin( p_attraction.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Rex Healthcare of Wakfield%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Raleigh%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' AND healthcare IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1 )::geography, 180000 ) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Rex Healthcare of Wakfield%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Raleigh%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NC%' AND healthcare IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1 ), p_attraction.geometry )) BETWEEN 202.5 AND 247.5;
